courses.deskripsi: Core grammar for everyday English — articles, pronouns, and essential verbs.

lessons.konten_teks:
An Article is a word used to modify a noun. There are two types: definite (the) and indefinite (a/an).

Examples: a car, an apple, the sun.
A pronoun replaces a noun to avoid repetition — I, you, he, she, they, we, it.
Learn when to use to be (am, is, are, was, were) and to have (have, has, had) in simple sentences.
